# Nodpay

> Nodpay lets UK businesses that bank with Starling Business delegate payroll
> without surrendering control: the finance person or bookkeeper prepares and
> checks the pay run in Nodpay (pulled straight from Xero Payroll, or uploaded
> as a spreadsheet from any payroll package), signs it off with a payment date,
> and the director approves the whole run with one tap — secured by their own
> bank's authorisation. Nodpay never holds the money.

## The problem it solves

Starling Business accounts only give payment access to directors/PSCs — there is
no bookkeeper or delegate payment role. So even when payroll is fully delegated,
a director must manually make the salary payments. Nodpay splits the authority
correctly: finance gets authority to prepare; the director keeps authority to
approve.

## Key facts

- Built for: UK businesses on Starling Business, ~2–100 employees. Xero Payroll
  integrates directly; any other payroll package works via spreadsheet upload
  (one row per person: name, sort code, account number, amount — template
  provided) with the same checks and exact bank-detail matching
- The bookkeeper/finance team never touches bank credentials
- Checks before sign-off: payee matching against saved bank payees, per-person
  deltas vs the previous run, new-payee and changed-bank-details flags
- The director approves via a secure link ("give it the nod") — no app install,
  no password
- Money moves directly from the company's own bank account; Nodpay is not a
  wallet and never takes custody of funds
- Pricing: £2 per pay run + 20p per employee. No subscription, no tiers, no
  contract. (12 employees ≈ £4.40/payday; 30 ≈ £8; 50 ≈ £12)
- Status: pilot — onboarding a small group of businesses; hello@nodpay.co.uk

## Links

- https://nodpay.co.uk — product site
- https://nodpay.co.uk/guides/starling-bookkeeper-payments/ — guide: why bookkeepers can't make payments from Starling Business, and how to delegate payroll without surrendering control
- Contact: hello@nodpay.co.uk

Nodpay is an Apexx Apps product. It is independent and not affiliated with
Starling Bank or Xero. Payments are initiated over Open Banking by an
FCA-authorised payment initiation provider.
